description: Java Spring Boot REST controller defining basic endpoints for the tictactoebackend application, including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the backend service.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI based on the incoming request URL.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application info.
